snippet.title: Mobile Suit Gundam: Gihren's Greed Startup and Intro - Sega Saturn (Japanese)
snippet.description:
The intro for Mobile Suit Gundam: Gihren's Greed for Sega Saturn. This is a strategy game, but one can get away playing it without much Japanese knowledge if you know the series well. 

All videos are recorded from real consoles via RGB to VGA, no emulation. [Kaikoshumi.net]
